artifact: Reviewed at 5978e5d; every commit since touched only .github/, context/, docs/ and reports/, and the staging artifact digest is byte-identical, so the reviewed rendering source is unchanged at this revision.

captures.page: Contracts: Cap Casualty Predictor team select is populated (was permanently empty under copy telling the player to choose a team); 3-Year Cap Projection no longer shows a team dropdown the panel cannot honour.
Contracts at 390px: both cap panels render the same corrected controls; no overflow.

Commissioner deck: lobby team select is populated, Queue Intent submits the previously dead Intent Type control, and Disband Lobby uses a light-theme-legible danger token instead of the dark-only #f85149. Negative QA metric deltas are readable.
Same deck in dark theme: no regression from the token change; danger red remains legible.

baseline.milestone: Pre-fix populated ticker remained hidden in the real browser because markup and renderer used different visibility controls.

findings: Cap Casualty Predictor now offers a populated team picker on desktop and at 390px; it previously shipped an empty select directly above copy instructing the player to choose a team.
The 3-Year Cap Projection team dropdown is removed rather than faked: the panel derives from the controlled club cap summary and cannot honour a per-team selection.
The multiplayer lobby team select is populated, so a player is no longer silently forced to join as their own club.
Queue Intent gives the Intent Type control a submit path to POST /api/commissioner/intent, which was fully implemented and contract-registered but unreachable.
Disband Lobby and the tone-negative surfaces now use the theme danger token; the inline #f85149 and six #ff8f8f literals had no light-theme path. Verified legible in light and unchanged in dark.
fixesApplied: Populate capCasualtyTeamSelect and joinTeamSelect in syncTeamSelects and honour the selection in the Run Analysis handler.
Add the Queue Intent button and wire it to the existing endpoint.
Replace seven hardcoded reds with var(--danger) and add a themed .danger-text class.
